fact: The Interior Minister's October 2025 circular to ten regional governors presses digitisation of civil status records into the national civil register, which under Law 36-21 gives a civil-social digital identifier at birth registration and exchanges data electronically with partners.
title: دورية جديدة من وزارة الداخلية لتسريع رقمنة سجلات الحالة المدنية
